mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, persistent inflation triggers aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 6-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 6-month moving averages, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%), payroll growth exceeding 150,000 jobs (PAYEMS > 150) signals sustained economic momentum that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 150, or joint effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output that correlates with stronger corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,400,000 units (HOUST < 1400), it signals residential sector weakness that reduces consumer confidence and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1400, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) signal aggressive monetary tightening that pressures equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a deceleration in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 YoY < 1.5%) signals economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion with GDPC1 YoY < 1.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
